info.title: Node Scalable Foundation API
info.description: Production-grade RESTful API with PostgreSQL, Redis caching, BullMQ queues, AWS S3/SES, and WebSockets.

get.description: Checks if the Node.js API process is up and running. Returns 200 OK.
Validates database, state Redis, and queue connections. Returns 503 during graceful shutdown or when degraded.

200.description: System is healthy and ready to accept traffic

503.description: System is degraded or shutting down

get.description: Returns the profile of the authenticated user (cached with Redis cache-aside).

patch.description: Updates mutable fields (e.g. name) of the authenticated user and invalidates cache.

get.description: Returns paginated list of all users. Requires platform_users:read permission.

get.summary: Get user details by ID (Platform Staff)
get.description: Returns full profile of specified user. Requires platform_users:read permission.

patch.description: Suspends, activates, or deactivates user account. Requires platform_users:suspend permission.

post.description: Creates a new user account with hashed password and returns access/refresh tokens.
Authenticates with email and password, returning JWT access and refresh tokens.
Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token and rotated refresh token. Accepts token via JSON body (mobile/API) or HttpOnly cookie (web).

requestBody.description: Refresh token payload (optional when using HttpOnly cookie)

post.description: Revokes the refresh token and clears auth cookies. Accepts token via JSON body (mobile) or HttpOnly cookie (web).

requestBody.description: Refresh token to revoke (optional when using HttpOnly cookie)

post.description: Generates a password reset token and enqueues a reset email via AWS SES.

200.description: Password reset email enqueued if account exists

post.description: Resets user password using a verified token received via email.
Sends a verification email. Can be called unauthenticated with an email body, or authenticated with a Bearer token / cookie.
Verifies email address using the token provided in the verification email.
Allows a system administrator to assume the identity of a target user for support/investigation with time-boxing and full audit logging.

requestBody.description: Target user ID, reason, and duration

400.description: Cannot impersonate yourself or invalid parameters

post.description: Terminates the active impersonation session in Redis and logs an audit exit event.

400.description: Not currently in an active impersonation session

post.description: Generates a pending TOTP secret and returns an otpauth URI for QR code pairing.
Validates code against pending secret and activates 2FA, returning 8 recovery codes.

400.description: Invalid verification code or setup expired

post.description: Requires current account password and valid TOTP code to disable 2FA.
Submits 6-digit TOTP or 10-character recovery code with challengeToken to complete login.

get.description: Checks whether 2FA is currently active on the logged-in user account.
Returns list of files uploaded in current tenant workspace with folder, search, and pagination support.

post.description: Creates a pending file record and returns short-lived AWS S3 presigned POST credentials for direct client-to-S3 upload.

400.description: Invalid file parameters or unsupported content type

post.description: Verifies that the object exists in S3, marks file as UPLOADED, and queues background virus/thumbnail processing.

400.description: File not found in S3 storage

get.description: Generates a short-lived presigned GET URL for downloading the file directly from S3.

patch.description: Updates file filename, description, tags, folder, or visibility.

delete.description: Soft-deletes file to trash by default, or permanently deletes if ?permanent=true is provided.

post.description: Restores a soft-deleted file back to active workspace status.

get.description: Returns list of folders in tenant workspace.

post.description: Creates a new folder for organizing files.
Creates a public expiring share link with optional password and download count cap.

get.description: Returns total bytes, file count, and category breakdown for tenant workspace.

post.summary: Rollback email template to a previous version
Send a test email with variable substitutions

403.description: Forbidden: test email must target user or active member

post.summary: Add an email address to the suppression list

delete.summary: Remove an email address from suppression list

post.summary: Queue an idempotent workspace member import
post.description: Requires members:invite. Repeating the same batch returns the existing job while its status is retained.

get.summary: Read progress for your workspace import job

post.description: Provisions a new tenant and sets the caller as OWNER with full permissions.

get.description: Returns all tenants where the authenticated user is an active member.

patch.description: Updates tenant organization settings such as display name.
Changes the workspace slug with DNS-label validation and creates a 90-day redirect from the old slug.

post.summary: Add or invite member to tenant

get.description: Exports workspace team members as a CSV or JSON report.

200.description: CSV file download or JSON list

post.description: Offboards a member, revokes active sessions, and optionally reassigns their owned resources to another member.

400.description: Bad Request (e.g. Last Owner protection or self-offboarding)

get.summary: Get tenant user group by ID

post.summary: Add members to tenant user group

400.description: One or more users are not active workspace members

get.summary: List modules with nested permissions tree
get.description: Retrieves all platform modules along with their configured permissions.

post.summary: Create a new module (System Admin only)
post.description: Registers a new platform module and optionally provisions initial permissions.

get.description: Retrieves a single module and its permissions.

patch.description: Updates module metadata like display name, description, icon, or sort order.

delete.description: Deletes a custom module. Built-in system modules cannot be deleted.

get.description: Catalog of granular permissions that can be assigned to custom roles.

post.summary: Create permission under a module (System Admin only)

get.summary: List available roles for a tenant
get.description: Returns both global system roles (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER) and custom tenant roles.

post.description: Creates a custom role and attaches granular permissions.

post.summary: Clone an existing role into a new custom role
post.description: Copies all permissions from an existing role (system or tenant) into a new custom tenant role.

get.summary: Explain permission access provenance for a tenant member
get.description: Returns detailed reasoning showing whether a member has access to a permission, including owner privileges, direct roles, group roles, and module enablement state.

get.summary: List modules with tenant enablement status

patch.summary: Enable or disable a module for a tenant (Feature Gating)

get.description: Returns all active states and UTs in India.
Returns child entities (districts, sub-districts, cities, villages) under a parent geo ID.
Looks up an Indian 6-digit PIN code and resolves its administrative hierarchy.

200.description: PIN details and resolved ancestor chain

get.description: Resolves GPS latitude and longitude to Indian administrative entities.
Fetch paginated in-app notifications for the authenticated user, optionally scoped to tenant.
Returns real-time unread notification count for the user and workspace.

get.summary: Get notification channel and quiet hour preferences

400.description: Invalid parameters or security override violated

post.description: Allows platform operators to dispatch broadcast notifications across workspaces, plans, or users.
